Dovebrook District New Life Project: Public Recruitment and Mental Healing Seminar at the Research Society of Happy Smiles
Confused about the future? Don't know where to turn?
Is the burden of life suffocating you?

You crash onto your bed after another grueling day, drifting aimlessly through the tide of memes OrchTok feeds you.
But when the screen fades to black, the reflection staring back reveals the truth... You aren't smiling.

You can't quite recall when it began, but you seem to have lost your reason to smile.
You try to force the corners of your mouth up when facing the mirror, but all you feel is a sense of alienation.

When was the last time... you really smiled?

Worry not! The Research Society of Happy Smiles is here for you!
Amidst the endless violence and spates of grisly crimes plaguing Dovebrook District...
The Research Society of Happy Smiles is hosting a week-long mental wellness seminar.
We are here to ease your burdens, answer your prayers, and help us all weather this storm together!

Once the star of the smash hit Please Be Happy and the people's beloved "daughter,"
now the president of the Research Society of Happy Smiles and director of Fulwish TV...

Fulwish

will also be making a special appearance soon! Together, we'll banish the gloom and rediscover the joy we've been missing!

No appointment needed! Just walk right in!
The Research Society of Happy Smiles is always right by your side.
